parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with mechanism of action classified as PARTIAL AGONIST. Join molecule_dictionary with drug_mechanism on molregno, filter drug_mechanism.action_type = 'PARTIAL AGONIST'. Join target_dictionary on drug_mechanism.tid to get target ChEMBL ID and name. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
